name: Rösslwirt
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Rösslwirt in Kirchberg in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, the **Rösslwirt** is a legendary mountain inn that has been welcoming guests since 1893. Whether you're craving hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a perfectly seared **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**, this cozy retreat offers a taste of authentic **Tirol** hospitality.

After a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the stunning landscapes around **Kirchberg in Tirol**, unwind in the rustic warmth of the **Rösslwirt**. The historic **Haus Rössl** also features a charming hotel, ensuring a full alpine experience—from gourmet dining to relaxation in the spa.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this iconic spot is the perfect blend of tradition and adventure, making it a must-visit for travelers seeking the soul of the **Tiroler** mountains.
